text: 68-year-old male presents with persistent cough and shortness of breath for 3 months. Patient reports unintentional weight loss of 15 lbs over the past 2 months. No significant past medical history. Social history: Former smoker, quit 10 years ago, 40 pack-year history. Physical examination reveals decreased breath sounds in the right lower lobe. Chest X-ray ordered showing suspicious mass in right lung. Recommend CT chest for further evaluation and possible biopsy. Patient scheduled for follow-up in 1 week to discuss imaging results.
